english.title: Manufacturer fail to record batches of vet medicinal product manufactured / assembled / supplied
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a manufacturing authorisation failed, as soon as reasonably practicable, to make a record of each batch of veterinary medicinal product, manufactured, assembled or supplied in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 21(1), 43(m) and 44(1) of the Veterinary Medicines Regulations 2013.

english.notes: From the 17th May 2024, this offence no longer applies due to changes made by the Veterinary Medicines (Amendment etc.) Regulations 2024. For the offence applying from this date, see H101680.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 282(2) and (3) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.
